title: Đề luyện Viết VSTEP — Recall RV0823

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

You have received an email from a friend saying that he and his family are going to visit you and your family during the winter holiday. Write an email to your friend. In your email you should say: 1. what clothes they should bring 2. what interesting indoor activities there are in your city 3. what they should buy as gifts for your family

writing — Task 2

Nowadays, many people tend to imitate their friends by buying the same new things, such as new clothes or the latest phones, that their friends have just bought. Do you think people should follow their friends in this way? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
